note: Front garden of the family house (outdoors, camera on the lawn facing north at the facade, as in the plan): kitchen window far left, green arched front door centre-left up the porch steps (-> R_entrance_04), open French doors of the dining room right (-> R_dining), garden wall and wrought-iron gate to the street at the right edge (-> S02_sector). Feminine left of x=816: girl passing the ball to the dog (passe), girl with a model villa and a calf (villa), priest blessing the lawn (propriete), demure lady (demeure), workman fixing the porch lamp (installation), ribbon-dancing girl (residence), bee hotel (habitation). Masculine right: man washing the outside of the upstairs window (exterieur), boy's lemonade stand table (etablissement), seal with a domino by the doghouse (domicile). Zoom: the porch steps -> R_entrance_03_z1. s02maison repaint 2026-10-22.
